notes: Boutiques by region: not found. The FY25 Annual Report and Non-Financial Report give only group totals (2,463 boutiques in the Richemont network, 1,392 directly operated), and the FY25 annual results presentation and the current Global presence page (2,357 monobrand boutiques) give no regional split, so no boutique rows were recorded. Employees by region come from the Non-Financial Report 2025 (headcount at end of March 2025); Japan is a reporting region that is a single country, so it is a country row. Regions are not defined by a country list in that table. No U.S. state data or taxes-by-country report was found. Regional headquarters are from the current (2026) Global presence page, newer than the FY25 snapshot.
